$comment: Test time limits (ms). 'deadline' is the hard limit for a whole test script: when it passes, the harness saves screenshots + logs to test/.artifacts/ and exits with code 124. 'step' bounds each wait inside a test. Override per run with OLR_TEST_DEADLINE_MS / OLR_TEST_STEP_MS.
$pdfTextMs: How long a test waits for a text to appear in the rendered PDF.
$spinCount: Busy-loop iterations in test/e2e/projects/slow (about 10 s per TeX pass in WASM), so a compile can be stopped.
$stopMaxMs: A stopped compile must end within this (the slow test document runs ~20 s if not stopped).
